changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Create complete medication_dispensing table with ALL columns
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE medication_dispensing ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, invoice_number VARCHAR(255), batch_code VARCHAR(255), dispensing_uuid VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE, provider_uuid VARCHAR(255), payer_uuid VARCHAR(255), insured_uuid VARCHAR(255), prescription_number VARCHAR(255), pharmacy_transaction_id VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE, dispensing_date DATE, prescribing_physician_name VARCHAR(255), prescribing_physician_id VARCHAR(255), recorded_at DATE, branch_name VARCHAR(255), claim_status VARCHAR(100), remark TEXT, status VARCHAR(50), claim_uuid VARCHAR(255), total_amount DECIMAL(15,2), patient_responsibility DECIMAL(15,2), insurance_coverage DECIMAL(15,2), pharmacist_notes TEXT, source VARCHAR(50), batch_id BIGINT, insured_id BIGINT, dependant_id BIGINT, deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, primary_diagnosis VARCHAR(500), secondary_diagnosis VARCHAR(500), attachment_file_name VARCHAR(255), attachment_content_type VARCHAR(100), attachment_data BYTEA );
CREATE INDEX idx_medication_dispensing_batch_code ON medication_dispensing(batch_code);
CREATE INDEX idx_medication_dispensing_provider_uuid ON medication_dispensing(provider_uuid);
CREATE INDEX idx_medication_dispensing_payer_uuid ON medication_dispensing(payer_uuid);
CREATE INDEX idx_medication_dispensing_status ON medication_dispensing(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_medication_dispensing_dispensing_date ON medication_dispensing(dispensing_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_medication_dispensing_deleted ON medication_dispensing(deleted);

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE medication_dispensing_item ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, item_uuid VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE, dispensing_id BIGINT, medication_code VARCHAR(255), medication_name VARCHAR(255), quantity DECIMAL(10,2), primary_diagnosis VARCHAR(500), secondary_diagnosis VARCHAR(500), unit_of_measure VARCHAR(100), unit_price DECIMAL(15,2), total_price DECIMAL(15,2), dosage_instructions TEXT, strength VARCHAR(255), route VARCHAR(255), formulation VARCHAR(255), item_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, remark TEXT, contract_detail_id BIGINT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (dispensing_id) REFERENCES medication_dispensing(id) );
CREATE INDEX idx_medication_dispensing_item_dispensing_id ON medication_dispensing_item(dispensing_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_medication_dispensing_item_item_uuid ON medication_dispensing_item(item_uuid);
CREATE INDEX idx_medication_dispensing_item_deleted ON medication_dispensing_item(deleted);
